name: Greenhouse Loft
website: https://arnold-weinberg-zgc3.squarespace.com/ (live site on a Squarespace subdomain; the domain the site itself declares, www.greenhouselofthp.com, now redirects to an unrelated online-gambling site)
what_they_do: Event rental venue on the second floor of a 1930s former garment factory at 431 Raritan Ave: weddings, birthdays, showers, graduations, workshops and photo shoots. Capacity up to 130 guests (80 seated, 84 seated per fire code), BYO catering and alcohol permitted, tables/chairs/Sonos/kitchenette included; flat day rates published: Mon-Thu $980, Friday $1,200, Sunday $1,680, Saturday $1,900, plus $90-100/hr for photo shoots and meetings.
customers: Couples and families booking private parties and small weddings within driving distance of Highland Park/New Brunswick; also photographers, meeting and workshop organisers.

size_signals.signal: One venue, one room, up to 130 guests; run by a small team that sets up and cleans (stated on site)
Booking window 2-12 months; 50% deposit plus signed contract to hold a date; $500 refundable damage deposit
4.6 from Google reviews, category 'Event venue', identified as women-owned; no phone, hours or website on the profile

listing.reviews: not shown in limited Maps view (directory citations report ~52-53 reviews)

website_review.phone_layout: no phone number published anywhere; mobile layout not separately tested (Squarespace template is responsive by default)
website_review.primary_cta: 'Contact' / 'Tours' - email greenhouselofthp@gmail.com or use the enquiry form
website_review.online_booking_or_quote: no booking or availability calendar - enquiries by email/form with a stated 'we will do our best to reply within 48 hours'; prices are published as text so a quote is largely self-serve
website_review.trust_signals: Photo gallery, published price list and full FAQ, 4.6 Google rating, women-owned badge, Instagram/Facebook links
website_review.out_of_date_signs: Website is still published on a Squarespace account subdomain (arnold-weinberg-zgc3.squarespace.com); the domain the site declares as its own now redirects to an Indonesian online-casino page; the LocalBusiness JSON-LD has empty telephone and empty openingHours fields
website_review.search_basics: Page title and description name the venue and town; separate pages for Photos, Our Space, Pricing & FAQ, Contact, Tours; no meta description on the homepage
top_issues: Brand domain is lost/hijacked: greenhouselofthp.com redirects to cavaliercorneronline.com (MEGA888 gambling)
Site only exists on a Squarespace preview subdomain - weak for trust, SEO and any link building
No online availability calendar or deposit payment; every booking starts with a 48-hour email reply, and the site itself tells enquirers not to email twice

agent_readiness.notes: Findable: Google profile exists with category and rating but has no phone, no hours and no website, so an agent cannot resolve contact details from the listing. Answerable: unusually good - prices, capacity, rules and FAQ are all real text plus LocalBusiness JSON-LD (address, email, name) that mostly matches the page, though telephone/openingHours are blank. Bookable: form has labelled fields but no calendar, no pricing calculator and no deposit payment; booking is by email.

operations_signals.signal: Enquiry promise is a 48-hour email reply, with a note that unavailable dates may not be answered at all
Manual contracting: 50% deposit and signed contract required to hold a date; remaining 50% a month before; damage deposit at check-in
Published last-minute discount rules (15% inside 28 days, two-day wedding bundle 25%) suggest frequent unsold dates handled by hand

top_opportunities.opportunity: Recover or replace the greenhouselofthp.com domain and move the site onto it (current domain sends visitors to a casino site)
top_opportunities.evidence: https://www.greenhouselofthp.com/ redirects to https://cavaliercorneronline.com/ showing 'MEGA888' gambling content; the Squarespace site's own JSON-LD lists that domain as canonical

top_opportunities.opportunity: Availability-aware enquiry handling: instant reply with availability, package price and deposit link, plus automatic follow-up on unanswered date enquiries
top_opportunities.evidence: Site says replies take up to 48 hours and unavailable-date enquiries may go unanswered; 2-12 month booking window; 50% deposit workflow is manual

top_opportunities.opportunity: Complete the Google Business Profile (phone, hours, website link, photos) so agents and maps users can act on it
top_opportunities.evidence: Maps profile shows 'Add place's phone number', 'Add hours' and 'Add website' prompts

scores.reasons: Gap: hijacked domain, no phone, no online booking - three serious, visible holes. Pay: venue takes $980-1,900 per event plus photo-shoot hours, a small but real revenue base. Ease: domain + booking + profile work is standard, fast delivery. Evidence: site, pricing, FAQ and listing all directly inspected.
